summary: Black Hills Corporation filed an 8-K to provide historical and pro forma financials for its pending all-stock merger with NorthWestern Energy Group, Inc. The merger, announced August 18, 2025, involves Black Hills acquiring NorthWestern via a merger subsidiary. Both boards unanimously approved the agreement. Conditions include approvals from state commissions and FERC. The filing updates deal mechanics but does not specify exchange ratio or implied value. Watch for regulatory timeline and any shareholder vote; the risk-arb spread will depend on the stock-for-stock exchange ratio and closing conditions.
